'''Contruum''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], and was the most developed planet in the dense system of inhabited worlds that made up the [[Contruum system/Legends|Contruum system]].<ref name="TUF" />

==Description==
Contruum was a [[Color/Legends|brown]] and blue world circled by [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]], two fair-sized [[Moon/Legends|moons]], and a mid-sized [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Contruum Shipyard|shipyard]].<ref name="TUF" /> Belonging to a dense system of inhabited worlds,<ref name="TUF" /> including [[Contruum Six]], Contruum itself was a tropical world<ref name="STRONG" /> with numerous cities on the equatorial band,<ref name="TUF" /> with enough farms and arable land on its surface to be considered an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]].<ref name="CRFG" />

It’s a megalopolis and industrious planet with ore-smelting plants, foundries, a modest shipbuilding franchise, and lucrative [[borium]] mining operations, Contruum was often touted as one of the most preeminent planets outside of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], and was compared to [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] in terms of power and prestige - though it was not remotely as ecologically devastated as the infamous polluted Eriadu - with no planet able to rival it in its part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TUF" />

Due to its position in industry, aspiring geologists, metallurgists, and engineers from all along the [[Vaathkree Trade Corridor/Legends|Vaathkree Trade Corridor]] flock to Contruum to study at its prestigious applied sciences colleges.<ref name="STRONG" /> Graduates and interns alike can easily find work-study programs and employment within the planet's foundries, shipyards, and mines, with multiple manufacturers of [[borium]]-tipped excavators and industrial drills recruiting heavily from Contruum's graduate pool.<ref name="STRONG" />

Equally famous for their spirit of courage and sacrifice,<ref name="TUF" /> Contruum has a rugged identity with a long history of invasions; with each invasion ending up with the inhabitants of Contruum rising up and driving invaders back into space.<ref name="CRFG" /><ref name="STRONG" /> During the [[rebellion era]] especially, Contruum waged a war of attrition against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] under the direction of [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]], who would go on to become the planet's most iconic contribution to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]; Airen made the war so costly to the Empire that shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] the Empire surrendered to Contruum's demands and withdrew from the system entirely.<ref name="STRONG" /> As a result, Contruum was one of the first planets to successfully throw off Imperial occupation, and became a galaxy-wide model for rebellion against the Empire; indeed, Contruum's reputation for insurrection was so powerful that it was slated for [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] had the battle for Yavin turned out differently.<ref name="STRONG" />

==History==
===The Imperial era===
In [[8 BBY/Legends|8 BBY]],<ref name="STRONG" /> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces seized control of the planet's Borium operations, expecting that such an action would meet little resistance from the rest of the planet's largely scattered and self-sufficient population.<ref name="CRFG" /> They were proved wrong when [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Airen Cracken]] and his team of mechanics organized themselves into a guerrilla group, known as [[Cracken's Crew/Legends|Cracken's Crew]].<ref name="CRFG" /> Avoiding direct attacks on the [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] forces, they wreaked havoc on the Imperial-controlled shipyards and mines, while disrupting the supply infrastructure of the occupation.<ref name="CRFG" /> As the Imperial garrison tried to deal with the saboteurs, a [[Contruum militia|planetary militia]] was raised, and after a [[Contruum rebellion|years-long war]], the local [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] opted to withdraw his troops, unable to justify the losses that the Empire was suffering in attempting to hold the world.<ref name="CRFG" />

Ultimately [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] and his son [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]] were considered heroes, and became two of the most iconic contributions of Contruum to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="CRFG" />

===The Yuuzhan Vong War===
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] Contruum was largely untouched, largely thanks to the efforts of [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]; after decades as head of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence for the Alliance]], Airen returned to his homeworld to personally oversee its defense.<ref name="TUF" /> To protect the world from invasion, the
[[Contruum Shipyard|orbital shipyards]] were abandoned, and a [[Contruum Moonbase|secret moonbase]] was established on the planet's innermost moon - giving the illusion that there was no military buildup or targets worth attacking.<ref name="TUF" /> In concert with newly-designed [[Hapes/Legends|Hapan]] [[pulse-gravity interdiction mine]]s at key [[hyperspace route]] exit points, the measures ensured that Contruum would stay beneath the notice of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], and if they did have visitors, that they could be trapped and [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]].<ref name="TUF" /> These tactics proved so effective that the Yuuzhan Vong did not make a serious direct assault on Contruum until the [[29 ABY/Legends|fifth year]] of the invasion.<ref name="TUF" />

During the fifth year of the invasion, the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], correctly anticipating a planned Yuuzhan Vong attack on their capital at [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], decided to concentrate half their available [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] around [[Contruum Six]], preparing to strike at Yuuzhan Vong controlled [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] while the invaders' fleet was on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] assaulting [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]].<ref name="TUF" />

While the Yuuzhan Vong did not directly locate the buildup focused around [[Contruum Six|Contruum 6]], their suspicions were aroused by the increasing numbers of [[Smugglers' Alliance]] ships passing through the system. As a result, during the [[Defense of Mon Calamari (Yuuzhan Vong War)|defense of Mon Calamari]], [[Warmaster]] [[Nas Choka]] ordered four of his fleet's battlegroups to break off their attack and strike at Contruum.<ref name="TUF" /> However, when [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] came out of hyperspace above Coruscant, all Yuuzhan Vong warships were recalled to defend their home base, and the fleet at Contruum turned around nearly immediately after entering the system.<ref name="TUF" /> Subsequently, Contruum was used as a staging point for Galactic Alliance forces in the lead up to the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar]], and entirely avoided any major conflict with the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="TUF" />

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]'', the map places Contruum in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], but the text places it in a "part of the Mid Rim."
